name: zhajinhua
description: 炸金花（ZhaJinHua）游戏 —— 共享逻辑与测试。type=module 使 Node 22 --experimental-strip-types 能直接转译 .ts（shared/、tests/、server/src/game/ 均在其作用域内）。

scripts.test: node --experimental-transform-types --experimental-loader ./tests/ts-resolver.mjs tests/handEvaluator.test.ts && node --experimental-transform-types --experimental-loader ./tests/ts-resolver.mjs tests/engine.test.ts && node --experimental-transform-types --experimental-loader ./tests/ts-resolver.mjs tests/bot.test.ts
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server start
scripts.start: npm run build:client && npm run start:server
